source_locator: R2297: B.I.33/a, Kutrzeba, 16 September, 26th Infantry Division fighting at Gogolina
current_activity: 26th Infantry Division is fighting at Gągolin, on the west bank of the Bzura, on 16 September
notes: Event date: sources covering 1939-09-16, cited below. Kutrzeba (PISM B.I.33/a, R2297) says that on the afternoon of 16 September 1939 the 26th Infantry Division had not crossed the Bzura and was fighting at Gogolina, on the west bank of the river. That fact was one of the reasons Bortnowski ordered Pomorze Army to withdraw. The pin is Gągolin Północny at 5 km, covering the adjacent Gągolin hamlets; Kutrzeba writes the name as Gogolina. Event definition: A dated headquarters, movement, engagement or withdrawal location in the September 1939 campaign. Event support: PISM B.I.33/a (R2297), the typed after-action account of Gen. Dyw. Tadeusz Kutrzeba, commander of Poznań Army. Memory account, uneven; used at confidence 0.5 unless an independent source agrees. Location and precision are given on the claim row.
